# KX Product Documentation — Full Reference
# Placed at: https://code.kx.com/llms-full.txt
# Updated: 2026-04-10

> code.kx.com is the official documentation hub for all KX products, including KDB-X (next-generation kdb+ ecosystem), kdb+/q (high-performance time-series database and vector programming language), PyKX (Python interface to kdb+), KDB.AI (vector database for AI), kdb Insights SDK (cloud-native microservices platform), kdb Insights Enterprise (managed enterprise deployment), KX Analyst, KX Developer, VS Code Extension, KX Delta Platform, KX Refinery, and Accelerators.

---

## KDB-X

KDB-X is the next generation of the kdb+ ecosystem, designed for real-time, data-intensive, and AI-driven applications at scale. It is built on kdb+ and powered by the array-based functional language q. KDB-X extends kdb+ with built-in AI libraries, modules (Parquet, SQL, Object Storage, REST Server), a Python interface, and MCP server integration.

### Getting Started
- [KDB-X Home](https://code.kx.com/kdb-x/index.html): Documentation home page.
- [About KDB-X](https://code.kx.com/kdb-x/get_started/kdb-x-get-started.html): What KDB-X is and how it differs from kdb+.
- [Install KDB-X](https://code.kx.com/kdb-x/get_started/kdb-x-install.html): Installation steps.
- [Install KDB-X Python](https://code.kx.com/kdb-x/get_started/kdb-x-python-install.html): Python interface install.
- [Brief Introduction to q and KDB-X](https://code.kx.com/kdb-x/learn/brief-introduction.html): Conceptual overview.
- [Tutorials Index](https://code.kx.com/kdb-x/learn/tutorials_and_examples.html): Tutorials and worked examples.
- [Q for Mortals (KDB-X edition)](https://code.kx.com/kdb-x/learn/q4m/index.html): Full textbook embedded in docs.

## kdb+ and q

kdb+ is a high-performance cross-platform historical time-series columnar database, an in-memory compute engine, a realtime streaming processor, and the q vector programming language.

### Getting Started
- [Overview](https://code.kx.com/q): Product home.
- [Install kdb+](https://code.kx.com/q/learn/install/)
- [Licensing](https://code.kx.com/q/learn/licensing/)
- [Learn Overview](https://code.kx.com/q/learn/)
- [Mountain Tour](https://code.kx.com/q/learn/tour/): Rapid q tour.
- [Q for Quants](https://code.kx.com/q/learn/brief-introduction/)
- [Q for Mortals 3](https://code.kx.com/q4m3/): Full online textbook.
- [Starting kdb+](https://code.kx.com/q/learn/startingkdb/): Structured intro — language, IPC, tables, HDB, RDB.

## PyKX (v3.1)

PyKX is a Python-first interface to kdb+ and q. It lets Python developers access kdb+'s speed for data processing and storage, and allows q developers to use Python's data science ecosystem.

### Getting Started
- [Install PyKX](https://code.kx.com/pykx/3.1/getting-started/installing.html)
- [Quickstart](https://code.kx.com/pykx/3.1/getting-started/quickstart.html)
- [What is PyKX?](https://code.kx.com/pykx/3.1/getting-started/what_is_pykx.html)

## kdb Insights SDK (v1.18)

kdb Insights SDK is a cloud-native, SQL-enabled kdb platform composed of kdb Insights Core, Stream Processor, Database microservice, and Reliable Transport. Full PyKX support is included.

### kdb Insights Core
- [Core Overview](https://code.kx.com/insights/1.18/core/index.html): Cloud-enabled kdb+ with SQL, object storage, packaging, logging, and REST.

## KX Tools

### KX Developer
- [KX Developer Overview](https://code.kx.com/developer/): Free graphical IDE for kdb+/q development.
- [KX Developer Libraries](https://code.kx.com/developer/libraries/): Pre-installed libraries.

### KX Analyst
- [KX Analyst Overview](https://code.kx.com/analyst/): Analytics and data exploration tool built on kdb+.

### VS Code Extension
- [VS Code Extension](https://code.kx.com/vscode/): kdb+ language support, query execution, and connection management for Visual Studio Code.

### KX Delta Platform
- [Delta Platform](https://code.kx.com/platform/): Event-driven streaming and analytics platform.

### KX Refinery
- [KX Refinery](https://code.kx.com/refinery/): Data quality and transformation product.

### Accelerators
- [Accelerators Overview](https://code.kx.com/accelerators/): Pre-built domain accelerators for finance, manufacturing, and other industries.
